note: Initial suite, authored with the pack (2026-07-09). Positives: imperative / diagnostic / symptom / indirect phrasings across the four axes (durations, easing/springs, choreography, reduced-motion). Negatives drawn adversarially from neighbors' trigger vocabulary: check-speed (perceived latency / skeletons / CWV) and material-motion-facts (md.sys.motion token values, design plugin) are the dangerous near-neighbors; plus make-component, ui-pattern-facts, check-ui-change, check-focus, check-colors.
